name: Floats
prompt: Create a videogame prop sprite atlas: exactly 20 individual spherical blown-glass fishing floats, 5 COLUMNS x 4 ROWS, generous transparent gutters, each orb entirely isolated and complete. Use the reference photo ONLY for the glass ball's spiral marbled translucent ribbons and glossy round shape; no hand, beach, ocean, sky or scenery. Clean outlined illustrated top-down handheld RPG style matching a detailed cozy coastal pixel-art town; readable at small game size, not photorealistic. Each float has a thin darker rim, spiraled colored glass, bright specular glints and visible internal curl. Colors in row-major order: seafoam, aqua, cobalt, rose, amber; lavender, emerald, sky blue, coral, pearl; teal, violet, ruby, lime, sunset orange; icy blue, magenta, moss green, honey, rainbow iridescent. All equal size, centered in equal cells, no shadows extending outside cells, no text, no numbers, no other objects. True transparent background. Keep all 20 spheres separated and uncropped.

name: Shells
prompt: Create one detailed videogame collectible shell sprite atlas, EXACTLY 10 COLUMNS x 5 ROWS = 50 COMPLETE SEPARATE SHELLS. Equal cells, generous transparent gutters, no overlap, no text, no numbers. Clean cute but natural illustrated handheld RPG art, crisp dark outlines, refined small highlights and ridges, matching a cozy detailed coastal town. Each COLUMN keeps its recognizable shell shape: 1 scallop fan, 2 conch, 3 cowrie, 4 chambered nautilus spiral, 5 sand dollar, 6 olive shell, 7 whelk spire, 8 ribbed cockle, 9 limpet cap, 10 turban shell spiral. Each ROW changes its color and pattern distinctly: row1 natural ivory/cream/peach; row2 blush pink/rose/coral; row3 seafoam/sage/moss green; row4 blue/turquoise/lavender; row5 pearly gold/rainbow iridescent. These are empty collectible seashells, no living animal bodies, no eyes or faces. Show each shell at a readable three-quarter view, consistent scale within cells, whole shell with pointed tips intact. No sand, scenery or cast shadows outside the shells. Transparent background. Landscape sheet at 2:1 aspect ratio, all 50 items clearly separated.

name: PropsCutout
prompt: Create an illustrated RPG beach prop sprite sheet, exactly 3 COLUMNS x 2 ROWS = 6 separate items, generous transparent gutters and no labels. Match detailed charming handheld coastal-town game art: crisp dark outlines, warm sand colors, mint/teal/coral accents, clean textured shading, three-quarter top-down view. Row1 col1: small fresh mound of sand with an overturned bucket; row1 col2: halfway built sandcastle, two short towers and a wall; row1 col3: finished impressive small sandcastle with four turrets, arched entrance, seashell details and tiny teal pennant. Row2 col1: a single colorful diamond-shaped kite viewed from below, teal and coral panels with a short ribbon tail, NO string (game draws string); row2 col2: kite-string spool resting beside a slim wooden beach stake, clearly recognizable at small size; row2 col3: a teal bucket with a coral hand shovel propped beside it. All items complete, detached, centered in equal cells, no people, no beach background, no text, no numbers, no shadows extending between cells. True transparent background.
editPrompt: Remove the entire background to true transparency. Keep exactly the six objects in their 3-column by 2-row grid. Preserve the artwork, outlines and details; leave transparent gutters.
